pages.text: $(thing)Vectors and Matrices$()$(br2)Arrows that add, and the grids of numbers that stretch and turn them. Most of physics, and every computer picture, is linear algebra.

$(thing)Insight$(): 35$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Number Systems, Euclid's Elements.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 2 Rational Field.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): A 2 x 2 matrix has trace T and determinant D. Write its larger eigenvalue λ.
